title: Technical Product Manager
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. raw.title: Technical Product Manager
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Hier schreibst du nicht nur Java – hier gestaltest du mit, wie das ganze Entwicklungsteam künftig mit KI Software baut.

Für ein international führendes Publishing-Tech-Unternehmen, suche ich eine:n erfahrene:n Java-Entwickler:in, die oder der KI-gestützte Entwicklung vom Experiment zum Standard macht.

Das Unternehmen

Das Unternehmen bringt seit über 15 Jahren Bücher in die digitale Welt. Auf einer selbst entwickelten Cloud-Plattform verwalten mehrere tausend Verlage ihre E-Books, Hörbücher und Podcasts – und bringen sie von dort in alle relevanten Shops, Streaming- und Abo-Dienste weltweit.

Die Company ist in den letzten Jahren stark gewachsen, wird von einem der großen internationalen Software-Investoren unterstützt und beschäftigt über 150 Menschen an Standorten in Europa sowie Nord- und Südamerika. Das Herz der Software-Entwicklung schlägt in Dortmund.

KI ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Geschäftsfeld: Von KI-vertonten Hörbüchern über die Lizenzierung von Verlagsinhalten an KI-Unternehmen bis zur besseren Auffindbarkeit von Inhalten.

Deine Mission

Das Dev-Team arbeitet bereits mit Claude Code. Jetzt geht es darum, KI-gestütztes Entwickeln richtig tief in den Prozess zu bringen. Du entwickelst die bestehenden Java-Produkte weiter und baust Neues - so, dass KI-Agenten einen großen Teil des Codes schreiben, während du Architektur, Qualität und Richtung verantwortest. Und du nimmst dein Team mit - mit funktionierenden Workflows, klaren Standards und ansteckender Begeisterung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst im Produktteam die etablierte Java-Plattform weiter und baust neue Lösungen für die Publishing-Branche.

  • Du machst KI-gestützte Entwicklung zum Standard: Du baust Workflows mit Claude Code & Co. auf, definierst Spezifikationen, Prompts, Konventionen und Review-Prozesse und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du sprichst direkt mit Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern, verstehst Anforderungen aus erster Hand und übersetzt sie in präzise Vorgaben für Mensch und Maschine.

  • Du gestaltest Software-Architektur, Systemdesign und Schnittstellen maßgeblich mit.

  • Du reviewst, testest und integrierst KI-generierten wie selbst geschriebenen Code und stellst Sicherheit, Performance und Wartbarkeit sicher.

  • Du befähigst dein Team durch Pairing, Wissensaustausch und interne Sessions und machst aus Skepsis Neugier.

  • Du bewertest neue KI-Tools und Modelle und entscheidest mit, welche den Entwicklungsprozess wirklich voranbringen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Java, Spring Boot und JPA/Hibernate

  • Solide Datenbank-Kenntnisse, idealerweise mit PostgreSQL

  • Erfahrung mit AWS, Docker, CI/CD (z. B. Jenkins) und Linux

  • Praxis mit KI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot oder OpenCode. Du weißt, wo sie glänzen und wo man genau hinschauen muss.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Architektur, Design Patterns und Clean Code sowie Sicherheitsbewusstsein (Secure Coding, OWASP)

  • Lust, Fachlichkeit wirklich zu verstehen, Anforderungen kritisch zu hinterfragen und andere mitzunehmen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

  • Ein Plus: TypeScript/React oder Python

Tech-Stack

Java · Spring Boot · Hibernate/JPA · PostgreSQL · TypeScript/React · AWS · Docker · Jenkins · Linux · Claude Code

Was dich erwartet

  • Gehalt zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 € p. a., abhängig von deiner Erfahrung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit einem Team, das vor Ort in Dortmund sitzt (2 Tage/Woche remote)

  • Eine Rolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie hier künftig entwickelt wird

  • Zugang zu aktuellen KI-Coding-Tools und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren

  • Ein Produkt mit Sinn: Bücher und Wissen in vielen Sprachen und Formaten zugänglich machen

  • Internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um dich up-to-date zu halten

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events

  • Bbetriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Weitere Corporate Benefits

  • Mitarbeiter-Rabatte

  • Eine JobRad Leasing-Option

Klingt das interessant & passend für dich?

Wenn ja, nimm jetzt Kontakt zu uns auf - dann können wir dir mehr über diese spannende Stelle erzählen und du kannst in Ruhe entscheiden, ob das eine tolle Option für dich wäre.

Du kannst einen professionellen Prozess und zeitnahe Reaktionen von uns erwarten. Auch unterstützen wir dich dabei, dich optimal zu präsentieren und begleiten dich mit Rat & Tat im Prozess.

Wir freuen uns schon sehr über deine Kontaktaufnahme!

- Ilias & Team #gernperdu

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.</p> <p>Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.</p> <p>This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.</li> <li>Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.</li> <li>Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.</li> <li>Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.</li> <li>Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.</li> <li>Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.</li> <li>Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.</li> <li>Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.</li> <li>Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.</li> <li>Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.</li> <li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.</li> <li>Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.</li> <li>Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.</li> <li>Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.</li> <li>Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.</li> <li>Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. For more information, visit <span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.workato.com/" data-tooltip-link-label="undefined">workato.com</a>.</span></span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><strong>Why join us?</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a <strong>flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles</strong>. We are driven by <strong>innovation </strong>and looking for<strong> team players </strong>who want to actively build our company.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">But, we also believe in <strong>balancing productivity with self-care</strong>. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment <span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="http://www.workato.com/careers">along with a multitude of benefits</a></span> they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Also, feel free to check out why:</span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.businessinsider.com/47-enterprise-startups-to-bet-your-career-on-in-2020-2019-12">Business Insider</a></span> named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.forbes.com/cloud100/#a57477b5f941">Forbes’ Cloud 100</a></span> recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><a style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);" href="https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);">Deloitte Tech Fast 500</span></a> ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><a style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);" href="https://qz.com/work/2053446/the-best-companies-for-working-from-home/"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);">Quartz</span></a> ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers</span></li> </ul></div><h1><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h1> <p>As our PostgreSQL DBA, you will be the go-to engineer for everything data-layer: index and schema design on multi-terabyte tables, query optimization for application teams, connection pooling, upgrades, and migrations. Our PostgreSQL runs on Amazon Aurora —&nbsp; operating a large, fast-growing fleet consistently: turning one-off procedures into reliable automation, keeping dozens of clusters healthy at once, and helping developers use the database well. You'll split your time between a support rotation for incoming developer requests and longer-cycle reliability and automation projects.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In this role, y</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">ou will also be responsible to:</span></p> <ul> <li> <p>Own day-to-day PostgreSQL operations across all production data centers: index creation on large/partitioned tables, query-plan analysis, schema reviews, data migrations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with application teams on data-model decisions — design, partitioning, retention, consolidation vs. standalone clusters — and push back with data when a design won't scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Operate and tune Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, replicas, failover behavior, capacity planning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run and evolve our PgBouncer connection-pooling layer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Turn manual runbooks into released, repeatable automation: seamless upgrade, switchover, database/user provisioning, grants management (Terraform + Ansible).</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive incident response and RCAs for database-related issues, and land the follow-up actions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain and improve database observability (postgres_exporter, VictoriaMetrics dashboards and alerts).</p> </li> <li> <p>Take part in the team's duty rotation handling developer requests, with protected focus time off-duty.</p> </li> </ul> <h1><strong>Requirements</strong></h1> <h3><strong>Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>5+ years of hands-on operational PostgreSQL experience (DBA / database reliability role).</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong command of query plans, indexing strategy, and performance work on multi-TB tables.</p> </li> <li> <p>Production experience with managed PostgreSQL (Aurora or RDS) and a clear-eyed view of its constraints.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices; comfortable in Linux.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with connection pooling (PgBouncer or similar) in production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Practical experience with logical replication, major-version upgrades, and low-downtime migration techniques.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scripting ability (Bash, Python or GO) and an automation-first mindset.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred); strong incident-management and RCA skills.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Operational exposure to ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or Redis/Valkey, Neo4j.</p> </li> <li> <p>Kubernetes fundamentals (our poolers, proxies, and exporters run on EKS).</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Vault, ArgoCD, or GitOps workflows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort using AI coding assistants to accelerate routine analysis and tooling.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tech Stack</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>AWS • Aurora PostgreSQL • Kubernetes • PgBouncer • Terraform • Ansible • VictoriaMetrics • Vault • Linux</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>(REQ ID: 2960)</strong></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We're on a mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. Multiverse works with over 1,500 leading companies globally to solve business-critical skills challenges. We launched in Germany this year via our acquisition of StackFuel and our ambition is big: upskill 100,000 learners as soon as possible.

The role

Multiverse Germany's MD Office is looking for a proactive, tech-forward and experienced Executive Business Partner (m/w/d) to support the Managing Director (MD) and Chief of Staff (CoS), to help run a fast-growing Berlin office. Executive and business operations support is the core of this role: your responsibility will lie in managing the diary of the MD and other senior leaders, helping to drive our overall business operations and company rhythm. With competing priorities inevitably arising, this role will require you to use your judgment to prevent unnecessary involvement of the MD in day-to-day situations or proactively involve him or the CoS when urgent. You'll also work closely with the UK team to keep Multiverse Germany aligned with company-wide rhythms.

In addition to that, you’ll have the option to help build a high-performance, high-agency culture (e.g., owning the internal event calendar and other initiatives) in the Berlin office. In doing all of the above, automation with AI runs through all of what you’ll do. Wherever a process is repeatable, you're expected and excited to use AI tools to speed things up.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support the MD primarily and provide additional support to other senior leaders, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently

  • Maintain and refine internal processes that support the MD, leadership team and the company

  • Manage professional and personal scheduling for the MD, including calendar management, preparing agendas, drafting emails, preparing phone calls or customer meeting briefings

  • Manage the MDs and senior executives’ travel logistics and activities, including accommodations, transportation, and meals

  • Automate where you can and use AI tools to cut manual admin across scheduling, reporting and follow-up

  • You are a strong communicator: you know when to raise a challenge, but even more so, you solve operational challenges them proactively before they reach the CoS or MD

  • You've done this before: several years as an EA, business or operations coordinator, or similar, ideally supporting leaders in a fast-paced or scaling environment

  • You think like an operator: you don't just execute tasks, you build the process, tracker or system behind them: every challenge is a problem about to be solved

  • You default to automation: you look to cut repeatable admin with AI tools rather than doing it by hand

  • You're discreet and trusted: you handle sensitive information with sound judgement

  • You're fluent in German, with strong conversational English: this is needed to coordinate closely with the UK team

title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software. We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades : Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload. This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work. You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage. The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows. Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products. Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows. Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases. Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration. Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions. Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop. Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention. Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart. Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows. Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments. Must-Have Skills 7+ years of product management experience , including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end. Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering. Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas , from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration. Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products , including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring. Strong customer discovery and product judgment , with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment , with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity. Proven cross-functional ownership , working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams. English at C1 level and German at C2 level. Willingness to stay close to customers and the team , including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent). Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI , particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows. Experience with AI monetisation , including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models. Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades . Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits . Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish . WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit. You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new. You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions. You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to. And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Flexibility : Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option. Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment : We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page . Diversity makes us better. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. title: Senior ML Research Scientist – AI & Generative Recommendation (f/m/d)
description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads , sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world's smartphones, connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem. Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Scalable Discovery & Engagement The Data Science Research team builds foundational ML representations and advanced AI capabilities that enhance both Playtime and adjoe Ads . Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI and deep learning approaches—specifically generative approaches —to deliver critical systems such as high-dimensional user embeddings , general content understanding and sequential recommendation . These frameworks scale adjoe's products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users. The team operates at the intersection of bleeding-edge R&D and high-scale production engineering, acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser and primary consulting layer for complex ML bottlenecks. The stack is optimized for deep learning and heavy data throughput: PyTorch and [Ray/Hugging Face] for training and fine-tuning foundation models, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure for heavy workloads. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain high-throughput, realtime production environments. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics, or an MSc with extensive industry research, and publications in top-tier venues like SIGIR, KDD, NeurIPS, or ICLR. You've spent 4+ years building large-scale recommender systems in high-throughput environments: AdTech, e-commerce, or social. You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. Deep expertise in PyTorch and large-scale model optimization. You have hands-on experience with high-concurrency optimization, model quantization, and distillation, the engineering side of getting large generative models to run under extreme production constraints, not just in research environments. Content understanding and embeddings are core to your work. title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind experics, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Boutique-Agentur für SEO und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aus Lingen. Mit über 200 betreuten Websites und Online-Shops, durchschnittlich mehr als 11 Jahren Erfahrung pro Consultant und dem European Search Award 2025 gehören wir zu den erfahrenen Spezialisten für organische Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Systemen wie ChatGPT oder Google Gemini. Durch diese Fachkenntnis sorgen wir dafür, dass mittelständische Unternehmen in Google und KI-Systemen gefunden, empfohlen und gekauft werden. Unsere Expertise ist längst da. Was noch fehlt, ist die entsprechende Sichtbarkeit am Markt. Bisher kümmert sich unsere Geschäftsleitung nebenbei um das Eigenmarketing. Doch wir haben größere Ziele. Und dafür brauchen wir dich. Du bekommst die Chance, unser Marketing nicht einfach nur zu betreuen, sondern aktiv aufzubauen und strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. Mit deinen Ideen und deiner Expertise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere fachliche Stärke endlich auch in unserer Außenwahrnehmung sichtbar wird. Dabei genießt du echten Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und kannst auf die Unterstützung erfahrener externer Spezialisten zurückgreifen. Aufgaben Events und Messen: Du planst unsere Auftritte auf Konferenzen und Messen und organisierst eigene Formate wie unseren experics Strategietag. Von der Idee über Location, Einladungen und Dienstleister bis zur Nachbereitung begleitest und koordinierst du den gesamten Prozess. E-Mail-Marketing und Leadmagneten: Du baust unser E-Mail-Marketing aus, entwickelst Leadmagneten wie unseren AI Search Blueprint weiter und richtest Nurturing-Strecken ein, die aus Interessenten Gesprächstermine machen. Thought Leadership: Du übersetzt das Wissen unserer Consultants in Inhalte, die der Markt liest. Fachartikel, PR, Beiträge in Fachmedien und Ghostwriting für den LinkedIn-Account unseres Geschäftsführers. Social Media: Du betreust unsere eigenen Kanäle, allen voran LinkedIn, und erstellst Grafiken und Short-Videos selbst. Das notwendige Equipment und die technischen Voraussetzungen stellen wir dir selbstverständlich zur Verfügung. Bewertungen und Kundenstimmen: Zufriedene Kunden soll man auch sehen. Du verantwortest unser Bewertungsmanagement und betreust einen festen Ablauf, mit dem wir regelmäßig Bewertungen und Kundenstimmen einholen und sinnvoll einsetzen, etwa auf der Website, in Angeboten und auf LinkedIn. SEO und GEO in eigener Sache: Du sorgst dafür, dass experics in Google und in KI-Suchen so gut gefunden wird wie unsere Kunden. Das Handwerk dafür lernst du direkt von unseren Consultants. Schnittstelle zu Dienstleistern: Du steuerst externe Partner wie Event- und Designagenturen oder unsere Beratung für Verkaufspsychologie und hast Budget und Zeitplan im Blick. Qualifikation Erfahrung: Du bringst 2 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing mit, idealerweise im B2B und am liebsten mit Agenturhintergrund. Sprache: Du schreibst auf Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau. Deine Texte sind klar, kommen auf den Punkt und brauchen kein Lektorat. Englisch ist ein Plus. Design und Video: Du arbeitest sicher mit Canva, Adobe oder Figma und produzierst Social-Media-Grafiken und Short-Videos selbst. Events: Erfahrung in der Organisation von Events oder Messeauftritten ist ein klares Plus. Lernbereitschaft: SEO- und GEO-Grundwissen ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist, dass du den Ehrgeiz mitbringst, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich auszubauen. Schließlich sind SEO und GEO unsere Kernthemen, die du auch nach außen vertreten wirst. Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst deine Themen selbst, triffst Entscheidungen und kommst nicht mit jeder Kleinigkeit zur Geschäftsleitung. Haltung: Du bist zuverlässig, packst an und suchst Lösungen statt Gründe, warum etwas nicht geht. Benefits 30 Tage Urlaub Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Ob private Termine, Sport oder persönliche Verpflichtungen – dank unserer Kernarbeitszeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr kannst du deinen Arbeitstag besser an dein Leben anpassen. Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Du erhältst eine unbefristete Festanstellung in unserem Büro in Lingen und profitierst vom direkten Austausch mit deinem Team. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Deine Ideen landen nicht in endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und kannst eigene Projekte schnell und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen. Lernen von Top-Experten: Du arbeitest mit einigen der besten Berater Deutschlands zusammen, beispielsweise aus den Bereichen Verkaufspsychologie und Eventmarketing, und profitierst unmittelbar von ihrer Erfahrung und ihrem Fachwissen. Budget für externe Spezialisten: Du musst nicht alles allein stemmen. Für die Umsetzung deiner Marketingprojekte steht dir ein Budget zur Verfügung, mit dem du bei Bedarf externe Experten einbinden kannst. Fachwissen mit Zukunft: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in SEO, GEO und KI-Suche und baust dir wertvolles Know-how in Bereichen auf, die für das digitale Marketing zunehmend an Bedeutung gewinnen. Zusätzliche Benefits: afs+ Mitgliedschaft, betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Deutschland-Ticket, Corporate Benefits und weitere attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Regelmäßige Team- und Unternehmensevents, bei denen auch der persönliche Austausch nicht zu kurz kommt. Bitte nur bewerben, wenn du: mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing hast auf Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau schreibst in Vollzeit vor Ort in Lingen arbeiten möchtest an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit interessiert bist Schick uns gern 2 bis 3 Arbeitsproben mit, zum Beispiel Texte, Grafiken oder ein Event-Konzept, das du verantwortet hast. Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Larissa Möller. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work. In this role, you will: Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software. Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption. Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability. Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform. Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value. Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools. Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development. Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders. Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed. Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows. Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an! Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft. Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Über uns Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. Unsere Technology Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. Deine Aufgaben Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme. Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen. Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen. Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen. Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung. Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare elektrotechnische Qualifikation. Praktische Erfahrung in der Elektroinstallation, Instandhaltung oder Betriebstechnik. Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung. Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen. Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team. Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Unsere Arbeitskultur Menschen stehen über Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität entscheidend. Wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst – und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance ein, in der berufliche Aufgaben sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind auf den Menschen ausgerichtet und ermöglichen es dir, dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren. Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial steht für uns an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir die Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen – für deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Deine Sicherheit und Zufriedenheit liegen uns heute und in Zukunft am Herzen. Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion bilden die Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir fördern Offenheit und schaffen ein Umfeld, das von Vertrauen und gegenseitigem Respekt geprägt ist. Individualität ist unsere gemeinsame Stärke und treibt Innovation und Fortschritt voran. Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen qualifizierter Menschen unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft und ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund. Wir schaffen ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung großgeschrieben werden. Werde Teil unseres Unternehmens und gestalte mit uns den Wandel in der Halbleiterindustrie. If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Gleichzeitig verbindest du Überzeugungskraft mit Empathie und einem starken Servicegedanken, genau das macht dich zu einer authentischen und überzeugenden Ansprechperson. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. raw.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen das größte Dämmungsunternehmen Deutschlands. Willst du von Anfang an dabei sein?

Vor wenigen Monaten haben wir Dämmung als eigenständiges Geschäftsfeld bei Enpal gestartet, und wir wachsen schnell. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Aufbau entscheidend mit. Du verantwortest Themen entlang des gesamten Funnels, von der ersten Kundenanfrage bis zur Installation, arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership zusammen und siehst unmittelbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

  • Du ownst die Business Cases für neue Initiativen und Angebote und entscheidest mit, was wir skalieren.

  • Du verantwortest die Performance unseres Funnels vom Lead bis zur Installation und setzt an den Hebeln an, die am meisten bewegen.

  • Du orchestrierst Projekte zwischen Sales, Operations und Bau und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen unser Angebot und unseren Pitch weiter.

  • Du treibst Automatisierung und KI voran, damit unsere Prozesse mit dem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in Venture Development, Business Development, Strategy oder Consulting mit, gerne auch aus einem Startup oder Scale-up.

  • Du bist zahlenaffin und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten.

  • Du denkst analytisch und in Prozessen und gehst trotzdem gern neue Wege.

  • Hohes Tempo und wechselnde Prioritäten motivieren dich, statt dich zu bremsen.

  • Du hast bereits Projekte mit vielen Beteiligten zum Erfolg gebracht und überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership und kommst auch ohne fertige Strukturen schnell ins Handeln.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

  • Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
raw.description:
About the role 

 

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. 
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. 
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. 
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. 
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. 
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. 
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. 
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. 
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. 

 

Joining Apaleo 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing. This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows. There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up. What You'll Be Doing Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks. Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered. Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging. Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery. Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff. Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns. Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction. Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product. What You Will Need Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth. Ability to design at the micro level - states, transitions, edge cases, and failure handling. Strong prototyping skills in Figma or equivalent tools. Experience working closely with engineers to ensure interactions are implemented as designed. Comfort designing for systems where output is non-deterministic and behavior can vary across sessions. Strong judgment on when users should be guided, interrupted, asked for confirmation, or left alone. How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.
