title: Growth Product Manager - Customer Acquisition (German Speaking)
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. Hybrid in Berlin or London We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument. The team The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert. The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates. The role This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate. The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions. Own the funnel from first visit to application Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it. Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next. Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first. Build with your technical squad Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring. Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca. Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon. Be the first call when the numbers look wrong Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems. Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice. Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers. Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes. Run the experiments that decide what ships Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows. Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis. Shape how a new team works Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products. Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built. Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics. Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on. The requirements Essential: Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes. Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools. Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms. Able to act as the product voice on modelling work – challenging assumptions and turning model output into decisions, without building the models yourself. Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative AI interaction to problem solve and increase productivity. Bonus: Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products. Experience working with data science teams or involvement in modelling projects. Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments. Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products. raw.title: Growth Product Manager - Customer Acquisition (German Speaking)
raw.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Hybrid in Berlin or London

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager

Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.

The team

The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert.

The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates.

The role

This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.

The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

Own the funnel from first visit to application

  • Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it.

  • Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next.

  • Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first.

Build with your technical squad

  • Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring.

  • Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca.

  • Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon.

Be the first call when the numbers look wrong

  • Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice.

  • Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers.

  • Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes.

Run the experiments that decide what ships

  • Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows.

  • Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis.

Shape how a new team works

  • Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products.

  • Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics.

  • Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes.

  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.

  • Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms.

  • Able to act as the product voice on modelling work – challenging assumptions and turning model output into decisions, without building the models yourself.

  • Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative AI interaction to problem solve and increase productivity.

Bonus:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.

  • Experience working with data science teams or involvement in modelling projects.

  • Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.

  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

  • Experience working in or helping build newly formed teams.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 - £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

title: Executive Director, Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacometrics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Your work will change lives. Including your own.&nbsp;</h2> <p><iframe style="width: 655px; height: 367px;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/NzerLX6koWI?si=0uGz2EwEH9kkOozz" width="655" height="367"></iframe></p></div><p><strong>The Impact You'll Make:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You will join an innovative and passionate clinical development team dedicated to improving the lives of patients suffering from devastating diseases.&nbsp; You will lead the innovative clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics strategy and execution for a portfolio of rare disease and oncology clinical programs.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Develop</strong> the clinical pharmacology and pharmacometric strategies to accelerate and support the overall product development plan. You’ll be the Clinical Pharmacology lead for various programs in clinical development, the representative for regulatory interactions, and propose innovative strategies to get therapies to patients faster.</li> <li><strong>Solve</strong> drug development questions/problems by performing and/or overseeing modeling and simulation with various tools to expedite decision making.</li> <li><strong>Design&nbsp;</strong>clinical studies. You’ll provide (clinical) pharmacology input on all clinical study designs, from Phase 1-3 and dedicated Phase 1 clinical pharmacology studies.</li> <li><strong>Author</strong> review relevant clinical pharmacology sections for regulatory documents, including Investigator's Brochures (IB), INDs, NDAs, and other regulatory submissions. Act as the clinical pharmacology expert during interactions with health authorities.</li> <li><strong>Interface</strong> with cross-functional teams. You’ll work closely with clinical study teams, translational teams (DMPK, Translational Modeling and Toxicology), preclinical teams and due diligence teams to ensure clinical pharmacology-related considerations are addressed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Team You’ll Join&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You will join the Pharmacometrics team within Recursion comprising clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and translational modeling. The Pharmacometrics group sits within Recursion’s Clinical Development organization. Team members get to sit on both Discovery and Development projects and work in a seamless end-to-end environment at Recursion. The team collaborates closely with clinical development functions (clinical science, clinical operations, regulatory affairs, biostatistics, etc.), as well as discovery functions (DMPK, Biology, Chemistry and Translational Biomarkers).&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Experience You’ll Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacokinetics or related discipline, M.D with a Clinical Pharmacology expertise, or a Pharm D. with a Clinical Pharmacology fellowship, with 10+ years of experience in biotech/pharmaceutical drug development.</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading all clinical pharmacology related aspects of drug development.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to work closely with internal and external stakeholders to manage PK, PK-PD, and PK-safety analyses, including non-compartmental analysis, population PK modeling, and PK-PD modeling and simulations to support dose selection, exposure-response and exposure-safety analyses through various phases of drug development.</li> <li>Proficiency with WinNonlin, Monolix, NONMEM, R or other modeling software.</li> <li>Effective skills directed toward driving collaboration, achieving results, influencing, and resolving conflicts across internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated experience responding to regulatory agency questions, preparing clinical pharmacology aspects of regulatory submissions and attending regulatory meetings.</li> <li>Highly motivated, decisive, and results-oriented individual who is proactive, resourceful, and efficient with the flexibility and creativity to excel in and contribute to a rapidly growing drug discovery and development company </li> </ul> <p>Experience in oncology is preferred, but not an absolute requirement.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Working Location &amp; Compensation:</strong></p> <p>This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom with required periodic travel.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Recursion, we believe that every employee should be compensated fairly. Based on the skills, experience, and qualifications needed for this role, the estimated annual base salary range is: <strong>£136,500</strong><strong>–£167,200</strong>.&nbsp;In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and a comprehensive benefits package.</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> <p>#LI-ES1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The Values We Hope You Share:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>We act boldly with integrity. </strong>We are unconstrained in our thinking, take calculated risks, and push boundaries, but never at the expense of ethics, science, or trust.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>We care deeply and engage directly. </strong>Caring means holding a deep sense of responsibility and respect - showing up, speaking honestly, and taking action.</li> <li><strong>We learn actively and adapt rapidly. </strong>Progress comes from doing. We experiment, test, and refine, embracing iteration over perfection.</li> <li><strong>We move with urgency because patients are waiting. </strong>Speed isn’t about rushing but about moving the needle every day.</li> <li><strong>We take ownership and accountability.</strong> Through ownership and accountability, we enable trust and autonomy—leaders take accountability for decisive action, and teams own outcomes together.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>We are One Recursion. </strong>True cross-functional collaboration is about trust, clarity, humility, and impact. Through sharing, we can be greater than the sum of our individual capabilities.</li> </ul> <p>Our values underpin the employee experience at Recursion. They are the character and personality of the company demonstrated through how we communicate, support one another, spend our time, make decisions, and celebrate collectively.</p> <p><strong>More About Recursion </strong></p> <p>Recursion (NASDAQ: RXRX) is a clinical-stage TechBio company decoding biology to radically improve lives. Recursion is advancing a portfolio of differentiated investigational medicines across its wholly owned and partnered pipeline in oncology, rare disease, neuroscience, immunology, and other therapeutic areas with significant unmet need. Enabling its mission is the Recursion OS, an AI-native, end-to-end drug discovery and development platform integrating biology, chemistry, and clinical development into a unified intelligence system. Powered by proprietary multimodal data, purpose-built AI models, and bilingual teams fluent in both science and AI, the Recursion OS is designed to translate complex science into medicines that matter — faster, better, and at scale — for patients who are waiting.<br><br>Recursion’s platform infrastructure is anchored in Salt Lake City, Utah and Milton Park, Oxfordshire, where its automated biology and chemistry laboratories generate proprietary data at industrial scale. Recursion also maintains offices in New York, Montréal, and London, three global hubs for talent and leadership at the intersection of AI and scientific innovation. Learn more at <u><a href="https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RX8_3OmD5YHn9KPS0dIZWI5SJTXw7o78IX71mdHWAptB3UnjQ7VNutoXIyTbG5D_sBzYYsRPGsSI2UDwEODguVwc0tsA_7kbn2hIXe7Xb8g=" target="_blank">www.recursion.com</a></u>, or connect on <u><a href="https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PEN8v5P4NfB9Je1Ehd4M665lSNOQWhGtMQkvFASBLBI-jFZV3X4qcj21uQ1akOvCKbQGxe8fC1gw7KzH_yFxhw==" target="_blank">X</a></u> and <u><a href="https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NZ3-__S7n3thuUCJDwe4LbKB3mL3beP5InfKrkM-PaMYe7yHWExchDgzH5kpuanTnSQt567E9X4FJ-sc4RRSbXAPzNGE7JsoG7bLhL2f84LlAk2rLmDecui7soYSVpUY" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></u>.</p> <p>Recursion is an Equal Opportunity Employer.&nbsp; All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, local, or provincial human rights legislation.&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.<em><br></em></span></p> <hr> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recursion leverages AI in our hiring process.</strong> We use Greenhouse's Talent Matching AI technology feature to help review applications against the skills and experience we've identified as important for this role. It analyzes your resume and application responses to assess how closely your qualifications match our criteria - but all decisions are made by our human recruiters and hiring managers, including whether to move to the next phase of review. Talent Matching does not automatically advance or reject any candidate.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have been informed about and consent to this use of the Talent Matching tool in our review process. Please refer to our Recursion Privacy Policy at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.recursion.com/privacy-notice/">https://www.recursion.com/privacy-notice/</a> for more information about our processing of personal data and your rights.&nbsp;</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment &amp; Staffing Agencies: </strong>Recursion Pharmaceuticals and its affiliate companies do not accept resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Recursion or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Recursion’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Recursion, and Recursion will not owe any referral or other fees. title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span><a href="https://poly.ai?utm_source=prnewswire&amp;utm_medium=pressrelease&amp;utm_campaign=boilerplate&amp;utm_content=pressrelease" target="_blank">PolyAI</a></span> is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&amp;E, and UniCredit.</span></sup></p></div><h3><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The role</span></sup></h3> <p><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Most AI agents are demos. Ours answer the phone for some of the biggest brands in the world: more than 100 million calls a year, across 2,000+ live deployments. Someone is on the line trying to move a booking, report a fault or pay a bill, and the agent either works or it doesn't.</span></sup></p> <p><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We looking for a Forward Deployment Engineer who has built and shipped LLM agents in production, including tool use and evals. Forward Deployed Engineers are the people who make it work. </span></sup><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You own a customer's agents from the first scoping call through to production and beyond. You design how the agent behaves, write the code that connects it to the customer's systems, put it on their phone lines, measure it and keep making it better.</span></sup></p> <p><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This is not sales engineering and it is not support. You ship code that runs in production, and you own what happens after it ships.</span></sup></p> <p><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We want someone who already builds agents because they can't help it, and who wants to do it at the hard end: real-time voice, messy enterprise systems, and callers who notice every mistake.</span></sup></p> <h3><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">What you'll do</span></sup></h3> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Own agents in production, end to end. Scope with the customer; design the conversation, the tools and the guardrails; build in Agent Studio and our ADK; launch; and stay accountable for how it performs.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You have built and shipped LLM agents in production, including tool use and evals&nbsp;</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Connect agents to the real world. Integrate CRMs, booking engines, payment flows and twenty-year-old APIs in Python. Work across SIP, telephony and contact-centre platforms. Make tool calls fast and reliable in the middle of a live conversation.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Debug live calls. When a call goes wrong, work out whether it was the speech recognition, the model, the prompt, an integration or the phone line, and fix the right thing.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Run agents like a scientist. Build eval sets from real calls, run A/B tests and let data decide what ships. Containment, resolution and caller experience are your numbers.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Close the gap to the platform. When you solve something for one customer, turn it into a reusable tool, template or product change so the next deployment is faster. Work directly with product, research and platform engineering, including the team training Raven, our own LLM built for customer service.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Be the technical lead the customer trusts. Run sessions with their engineering, operations and executive teams. Explain trade-offs plainly. Say no when no is the right answer.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Work AI-native. You use coding agents and LLM tooling every day, and you help the people around you do the same.</span></sup></li> </ul> <h3><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You'll fit if</span></sup></h3> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You have shipped LLM-powered agents or conversational systems to real users, and you can show us one.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You write strong Python and are at home in production code, APIs and integrations, including codebases you didn't write.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You have several years in a technical, customer-facing engineering role: forward deployed, solutions engineering that ships real code, consulting engineering, or a startup where you were the engineer customers called.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You own outcomes, not tickets. You have been the person on call when it broke, and you liked it.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You can explain a latency budget to an engineer and a containment trade-off to a COO in the same afternoon.</span></sup></li> </ul> <h3><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Even better</span></sup></h3> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Voice and telephony: SIP, IVR, CCaaS platforms, real-time audio.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Evals and experimentation, or an ML background: you have built a test set or run an online experiment.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Regulated industries such as healthcare, utilities or financial services.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Go or C++, or high-throughput real-time systems.</span></sup></li> </ul> <h3><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Why PolyAI</span></sup></h3> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Voice is the hard channel, and it's all we do. Real-time, interruptible, noisy, on phone lines built decades ago. Doing it well at enterprise scale is a moat, and you will learn things here you can't learn anywhere else.</span></sup></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We own the stack that matters. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="acronym-highlight">OPSWAT</span>, a global leader in IT, <span class="acronym-highlight">OT</span>, and <span class="acronym-highlight">ICS</span> critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.</p></div><div class="row"> <div class="col-12 col-lg-8 col-xl-7 col-xxl-5">&nbsp;</div> </div> <h3>A personal note from Andreea, Global Head of HR</h3> <p>I'm Andreea, Global Head of HR at OPSWAT.&nbsp;OPSWAT is also the kind of place where opportunities tend to find the people willing to take them on. I’d love to shape what it looks like together with someone who shares that mindset, but who will also bring their own perspective and challenge my thinking along the way. raw.description:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Salience Labs, you’ll be right at the centre of our photonics product development. This role spans low-level firmware, rapid prototyping, and systems integration, giving you the chance to influence everything from proof-of-concept devices to our commercial platforms. You’ll collaborate across hardware, photonics, and FPGA teams to ensure smooth, efficient embedded software development, right down to the register level and all the way up to application-facing tools.

This is a full-stack embedded role, where versatility and curiosity are just as important as technical depth. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working close to the metal, but can just as easily contribute to user-facing tools and test infrastructure. You’ll be part of a small, fast-paced team where autonomy is encouraged and impact is tangible.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, implement, and document embedded software across a variety of project scales

  • Work closely with hardware and FPGA teams to build robust embedded systems

  • Use off-the-shelf development kits for rapid prototyping and system testing

  • Select, tailor, and integrate open-source applications and embedded frameworks

  • Collaborate with the Systems Test team to support test automation and data capture

  • Develop internal tools and test benches for the photonics and hardware teams

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience developing embedded software in C or C++

  • Proven ability to own software modules from design to delivery

  • Comfortable using Python and modern tooling (Git, Confluence, Jira)

  • Strong problem-solver with clear analytical thinking and communication skills

  • Flexible team player, able to switch between solo work and close collaboration

Even better if you

  • Can read schematics or interpret RTL, particularly helpful for supporting hardware teams

  • Have experience developing for ARM-based embedded platforms

  • Know your way around I2C, SPI, PCIe, and embedded driver development

  • Understand networking concepts

  • Are comfortable becoming a domain expert in unfamiliar tools or technologies

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on building, testing, and iterating in real hardware environments. If you’re looking for a deeply technical role where you can have influence across the full product stack, and you like the sound of building the software brains of next-gen optical systems, then we’d love to hear from you.

description: Localisation Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon.    Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets , vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants. Vos missions ·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire. ·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires. ·         Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain. ·         Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques. ·         Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions. ·         Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets. ·         Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux. ·         Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement. ·         Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial. Votre profil ·         Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural. ·         Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial). ·         Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation. ·         Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux. ·         Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets. ·         Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.   Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ? 💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours. 🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance. 🌴 Une prime vacances. 🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50%  🚗 Une voiture de fonction. 🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous. 📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS). 🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse.    Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation.    Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.  Intéressé(e) ? Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? ·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

·         Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain.

·         Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques.

·         Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions.

·         Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets.

·         Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux.

·         Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement.

·         Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial.

Votre profil

·         Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

·         Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial).

·         Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.

·         Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux.

·         Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

·         Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

 

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.

🚗 Une voiture de fonction.

🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble.

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation.

Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.</p> <p><strong>Changeons la donne pour de bon.</strong> Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

The role

Ideals has been in the Virtual Data Room space since 2008 and has built a trusted reputation with clients across multiple industries in Europe, including Deloitte, and EY.

To support the next stage of Ideals VDR growth in France, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive based in Paris. Joining our French Key Accounts team, you will own the full new business sales cycle and sell directly to a wide variety of enterprise corporations across diverse industries (such as energy, pharma, biotech, telecommunications, etc.).

As a quota-carrying strategic seller, your primary goal will be to grow sales and revenue through the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts and the expansion of existing ones. You will act as an impactful industry expert, generating demand, navigating complex 6 to 9-month sales cycles, and displacing incumbents by utilizing deep discovery and consultative selling frameworks.

Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable.

Why Ideals?

  • Industry-leading sales culture: Ideals ranks among the top companies on RepVue, as rated by sales professionals. You’ll be empowered with dedicated Sales Enablement, RevOps, Marketing support, and a structured onboarding ramp.

  • Stable growth: You’ll join a profitable, bootstrapped SaaS company that is positioned to deliver 5x revenue expansion and reach unicorn status in the next 5 years. The deals you close will shape Ideals' footprint in France and feed into our global scaling ambition.

  • Sales motion built on regional nuance: You’ll be part of a European-headquartered org, with over 18 years of selling in the VDR business. You'll drive GTM in the region we understand deeply, backed by a product that already powers 10%+ of global M&A activity.

What you will do

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline focused on the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts (new logos)

  • Conduct solution-based sales engagements, including client meetings, executive presentations, and product demonstrations (face-to-face and virtual)

  • Maintain "White Space" analysis and execute strategic initiatives to upsell and cross-sell within the existing customer base

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive business cases that quantify the cost of inaction and address customer priorities, pain points, and ROI

  • Structure, negotiate, and close complex deals, guiding corporate clients step-by-step through enterprise procurement, security compliance, and legal processes

  • Orchestrate multi-threading strategies to navigate enterprise politics, establishing strong relationships with C-Suite executives and key stakeholders across various verticals

  • Keep an accurate track record of personal sales activities in the CRM, including methodical mid- and long-term forecasting

  • Provide relevant customer feedback to the product development team and collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, and Inbound Sales to maximize revenue and customer satisfaction

What you bring

  • 4–7 years of demonstrable quota-carrying success in B2B sales

  • Proven track record of managing lengthy or complex enterprise sales cycles

  • Significant experience selling directly to C-level executives (CxOs) and multi-threading within large enterprise organizations

  • Clear understanding of, and practical experience with, consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDPIC, SPIN, Challenger)

  • Exceptional business communication skills, enabling you to execute executive storytelling, challenge the status quo, and handle complex contracting negotiations

  • High learning agility, analytical thinking, and commercial curiosity to quickly grasp the nuances of various corporate industries

  • High AI fluency and advanced CRM tracking skills

  • Native-level proficiency in French with professional English level (C1+)

  • Based in Paris or within a realistic commuting distance for regular in-person client meetings

Nice to have

  • Background in SaaS, financial technology, or information security sectors

  • Familiarity with enterprise M&A use cases and corporate compliance workflows

What we offer

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

For your best work

  • Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday

  • Home workplace budget

  • Co-working expense coverage

  • Individual IT budget for extra equipment

  • Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

For your growth

  • Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses

  • Investment in external learning and development activities

  • Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation

  • Professional literature and subscriptions coverage

  • Support of your passion as a speaker or writer

  • Internal talent mobility opportunities

For your well-being

  • Tailored Wellness Package to support your physical and mental health

  • Urban Sports membership

  • Funding for sports competitions

  • 25 business days of paid time off per year

  • Paid health-related time off

Extra perks

  • Budget for team gatherings

  • Generous internal referral program

Our culture

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more.

Ideals is an equal opportunity employer

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, or citizenship.

raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely.

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists.

Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios.

  • Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise.

  • Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs.

  • Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code.

  • Partner with researchers and security specialists across Mistral, distilling their domain expertise into reproducible environments and datasets.

  • Write clear, efficient code in Python and enforce strong software-design practices: testing, code review, CI/CD.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on expertise in offensive and/or defensive cybersecurity: vulnerability analysis, web/network/cloud security, secure coding practices, and SOC.

  • Strong software engineering skills: clean, reliable, well-tested code — not just exploit scripts.

  • Fluency in Python plus comfort reading lower-level languages (C/C++) for vulnerability analysis.

  • DevOps experience: Docker, Kubernetes, cloud deployments, sandboxed or simulated environments.

  • A pragmatic research-to-engineering mindset: ship a working first version, then refine and scale it.

  • Working knowledge of RL techniques and LLM training methodologies, or strong motivation to develop it.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative — comfortable working across research and engineering.

Nice-to-haves

  • CTF, cyber-range, or bug-bounty experience — as a player, challenge author, or platform builder.

  • A research background in cybersecurity, academic or industrial, or in another experimental discipline.

  • Prior experience building RL environments or large-scale ML training infrastructure.

  • Relevant open-source contributions and projects.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Chef.fe de Projet Applicatifs Hôpitaux
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service. En tant que Chef.fe de projet, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement. Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement. Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions. Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D. Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain. Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés. Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques. Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé. Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données. La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire. Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes. Nice-to-have Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé. Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes. L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels. Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet. Soft skills Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs. Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes. Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé. 👥 Process de recrutement Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste. Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. Cet échange permet de discuter de ta façon de travailler, de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes et de revenir sur d’éventuels sujets à approfondir après les premières étapes. Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures suivant chaque étape. Compensation: €44K – €49K • €44K – €49K Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

At Back Market, we're on a mission to prolong the life of electronics — because a phone that's already been made is always smarter than making a new one. With around 700 Backmakers across Paris, Bordeaux, Barcelona, New York, and Tokyo, we're growing fast, and our People ambition is growing with us.

We're redesigning how the People function works from the inside out — dedicated expertise hubs, one shared language for hiring, assessing, developing, and promoting. The Talent hub brings Talent Acquisition and Talent Development under one roof, and we're looking for the person who will own the development side of that equation.

This is the role that shapes how 700 people grow, progress, and get recognised. It's a builder's job as much as an operator's job — you'll design the systems, not just run them.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT) 🥇

You'll own Back Market's Talent Development practice end to end — connecting performance, careers, skills, learning, and succession into one system that managers actually use and Backmakers actually trust.

What you'll work on:

  • Land the redesigned People Cycle — annual review, mid-year career conversation, calibration, and L6–L7 promotion committee — with retroplans, Workday configuration, and a manager training wave from day one

  • Build the job and competency framework on our Career Architecture, together with Talent Acquisition and Rewards, so that hiring, leveling, assessment, and pay all speak the same language

  • Lead the Workday Talent module remaster and the Workday Learning deployment as business owner, working with HR Tech as your system owner counterpart

  • Redesign our learning offer — who learns what, when, and through which channel — while delivering priority programmes for managers and teams in the meantime

  • Manage and grow a team of 2 to 3 FTE; set the roadmap, balance run vs. build, and make the case for headcount as programmes land

  • Co-own the Talent hub roadmap with the Head of Talent Acquisition and represent Talent Development in the People leadership team and with the Exco

 

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF ⭐

You have:

  • 10+ years in talent management, talent development, or learning — with a track record of building (not only running) performance cycles and competency frameworks in a fast-growing, international company

  • Hands-on experience with a Workday Talent or Learning deployment as business owner, or an equivalent HRIS talent suite

  • Learning budget ownership and real build-versus-buy decisions — vendors, content strategy, the works

  • Experience managing and growing a team of talent or learning professionals

  • The ability to lead without hierarchy — with People Partners, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners who don't report to you

  • Excellent communication skills in English; French is a strong plus

Nice to have:

  • Multi-country experience across Europe, the US, or Asia

  • Background in a scale-up or tech environment

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

  • Call with Julie, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (45min)

  • Technical Interview (1h)

  • Internal Stakeholder / team interview (45min)

  • Leadership interview (45min)

  • Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)

ABOUT THE ROLE:

  • Head of - Management role

  • Based in Paris or Bordeaux, France

  • Hybrid - 3 days per week at the office mandatory

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work. In this role, you will: Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software. Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption. Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability. Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform. Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value. Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools. Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development. Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders. Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed. Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows. Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . Tes futures missions : Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide. Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique. Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers. Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail. Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations. Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets. Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs. Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data. Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide. La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ? Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge. Nos avantages Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly. Nos avantages : Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies. Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts. Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour.  25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur. Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail. Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios. Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée. Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils. Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites. Envie d'en savoir plus ? On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi. title: Customer Success Public Sector
description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy   Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:   - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently   Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐   At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. You will join Malt as a Customer Onboarding & Success Manager - Public Sector , based in Paris Manager Customer Success - Global, Public sector & SMB, you will work hand-in-hand and transversally with our Account Managers dedicated to the Public Sector.  Your main mission will be to ensure the smooth deployment and flawless execution of framework agreements ( accords-cadres ) and public tenders throughout their lifecycle. You will be the guarantor of compliance with public procedures and tracking commitments, acting as the primary operational point of contact for public beneficiaries and freelancers. Key responsibilities ✨ Onboarding & Pedagogy: Pitch platform benefits, lead training sessions, and perform product demos to drive user independence within ministries, local authorities, and public institutions. Public Tender Execution & Tracking: Anticipate the end of purchase orders or contracts, and provide proactive follow-ups to ensure business continuity and secure renewals (contract renewals, new market lots). Public Administrative & Budgetary Management: Pilot operational processes specific to the public sector (management and compliance of quotes/purchase orders, tracking Legal Commitments ( Engagements Juridiques ), validating activity reports/CRA for non-autonomous clients), and monitor budget consumption. Beneficiary Relations & Satisfaction: Act as the dedicated go-to person to centralize requests from public decision-makers and resolve operational incidents. Contractual Expertise (SLAs & CCAG): Master the specificities of technical/administrative specifications (CCTP, CCAP, CCAG) and service level agreements (SLAs) unique to each framework agreement to align our internal ways of working. Continuous Improvement: Identify operational pain points unique to public administrative processes and collaborate with Ops, Product, and Tech teams to automate and adapt our platform to public sector constraints. About you 🧑‍🚀 Experience: A previous public sector experience is mandatory for this job ! Solid background in managing complex client relationships, onboarding large accounts, or operational contract management Administrative Rigor: A keen sense of organization and familiarity with the inner workings of public administration (notions of public procurement, purchase orders, Chorus Pro, and budgetary validation workflows). Solution-Oriented: Excellent interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to resolve disputes or complex situations with a variety of stakeholders (from Procurement Directors to technical Project Managers). Tools & Data: Advanced proficiency in collaborative and analytical tools (Gsheet/Excel, Notion, Looker) and an appetite for AI applications. Languages: Native/fluent level of French (essential for dealing with the French administration) and professional level of English (as internal processes and the Malt team are international). How to join the mission? 🚀 First call with our Talent Acquisition team to better understand your background and aspirations (30-45 minutes).
