raw.title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
raw.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners in France that are not yet strategic, including digital transformation and AI consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners

  • Agree on focused joint plans with each priority partner, including target accounts, customer problems, sellable offers, measurable outcomes, owners, and next steps

  • Identify promising new solution partner relationships and qualify them on customer access, strategic fit, delivery capability, and willingness to invest in a joint motion

  • Help partners turn their existing expertise and customer relationships into a clear path to working with Dust

  • Maintain a reliable view of partner pipeline, deal progress, risks, and expected contribution in Dust's CRM and reporting processes

Enable partners to sell and support Dust

  • Run practical partner onboarding and enablement so partner teams can explain Dust, identify relevant use cases, and participate confidently in customer conversations

  • Coordinate product, sales, and deployment guidance with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner Delivery; help partners become increasingly self-sufficient without taking on delivery ownership

  • Share relevant customer stories, use cases, and sales materials, and identify gaps in the enablement partners need to move opportunities forward

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

Vos missions principales :

title: Stage de Vente - Nice Cap 3000
description: À PROPOS DE LA MARQUE Chez Karl Lagerfeld, nous suivons le mantra suivant : « Profiter du présent et inventer le futur ».   Toujours contemporaine et tournée vers l’avenir, la maison KARL LAGERFELD partage la vision créative et l’esthétique de son fondateur emblématique, Karl Lagerfeld.   Nous sommes la seule maison de couture portant le nom de Karl et nous nous efforçons d’être à la hauteur de cette responsabilité dans tout ce que nous réalisons, chaque jour, avec la plus grande joie et passion.   Nos sièges de Paris et d’Amsterdam accueillent une équipe diversifiée et motivée de membres de la famille KARL venant de plus de 35 pays différents. Ensemble, nous visons à créer des histoires pleines de sens ainsi que des concepts de produit liés au monde et aux attributs emblématiques de Karl.   Le prêt à porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont gérés directement depuis notre siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que d’autres catégories, incluant le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie et autres, sont développés avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS est de la même manière gérée en dehors de notre siège d’Amsterdam et est notre gamme connaissant la croissance la plus rapide.   Nous sommes en contact avec nos consommateurs à différents niveaux, nous assurant que notre approche à la fois en ligne et hors ligne aillent de pair. Nous nous efforçons d’optimiser l’engagement de nos clients avec plus de 200 magasins KL dans le monde, nos partenaires grossistes premium, et notre couverture numérique, avec à sa position le flagship store KARL.COM, qui est disponible dans 96 pays. Nos canaux numériques représentent plus de 30% de notre activité à plein tarif.   Nous sommes une entreprise dynamique, à la croissance rapide et inclusive construite sur le professionnalisme et des valeurs fortes. Chez KARL KAGERFELD, nous nous engageons à travailler avec les plus hautes normes en matière de durabilité et d’intégrité dans tous nos domaines d’activité. En 2019, KARL LAGERFELD a rejoint la Fashion Pact, une initiative de durabilité mondiale cherchant à transformer le secteur de la mode par le biais d’objectifs dans trois différents domaines : climat, biodiversité et protection des océans, en tant que membre fondateur. POSITION La Maison KARL LAGERFELD souhaite contribuer à la formation et au succès de futurs jeunes talents de la mode. C’est dans ce but que nous proposons des stages conventionnés à temps plein pour une période de 6 mois en tant qu’assistant(e)s de ventes. Le stage se déroulera au sein de nos corners en Grands Magasins à Nice Massena ou Nice Cap 3000.   Ambassadeur de la Maison KARL LAGERFELD, vous aurez pour mission: - Assurer le meilleur accueil et service auprès d’une clientèle française et internationale - Participer à la réalisation du chiffre d’affaires - Participer à la mise en place du Merchandising - Assurer le Réassort - S’assurer de la bonne gestion des stocks - Nous vous garantissons un suivi pédagogique allié un à environnement formateur et enrichissant.   PROFIL Pour mener à bien ce stage, le profil suivant est requis : Vous êtes doté d’une réelle finesse relationnelle, vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens du service Dynamique et enthousiaste, vous avez le goût du challenge et de la vente. Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais Vous êtes curieux, doté d'une personnalité cool et dynamique Enfin, votre esprit d’équipe, votre implication et votre état d’esprit positif vous assureront une parfaite intégration au sein de notre Maison   Convention de stage obligatoire - Compensation ou rémunération selon la législation. Start date: March 5th, 2026 REJOIGNEZ LA #TEAMKARL La vision collective de KARL LAGERFELD est d’être la marque de créateur mondiale la plus connectée, inspirant les consommateurs grâce à de luxueuses collections et les immergeant dans le Monde de Karl. Si cela vous intéresserait de rejoindre la #TEAMKARL, nous vous invitons à nous soumettre votre candidature dès aujourd’hui.   Au sein de la #TEAMKARL, chacun a la liberté de donner son opinion, de faire évoluer sa carrière et de faire partie d’une équipe attentionnée et inclusive. Nous invitons les personnes de différents horizons, avec différentes perspectives, idées et expériences, à travailler avec nous.     IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING JOB POSTINGS   Please be advised that all legitimate job opportunities at KARL LAGERFELD are published exclusively on our official careers page and on selected partner platforms that redirect directly to our career site.   We strongly recommend applicants to only apply through our verified channels and remain vigilant against unofficial job offers.   KARL LAGERFELD will never request any form of payment during the recruitment process.   If you come across suspicious job postings or receive unexpected communication about a position, please contact us immediately at ----- Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany. Please submit your CV in English About the role: We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform. In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems. In particular, you will be responsible for: Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies. Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers. Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance. Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows. Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. About you Required qualifications / experience: Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field. Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets. Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models. Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models. Technical stack: Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks ( PyTorch , Hugging Face ecosystem). Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques. Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5). Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data). Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals. #LI-HB1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability. Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information: Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn. Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @ owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby). The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @ Owkin.com . The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information; Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). Constitué de huit Grandes Écoles publiques : IMT Atlantique, IMT Mines Albi, IMT Mines Alès, IMT Nord Europe, Institut Mines-Télécom Business School, Mines Saint-Étienne, Télécom Paris et Télécom SudParis, et de 2 écoles filiales : EURECOM et InSIC, l’Institut Mines-Télécom anime et développe un riche écosystème d’écoles partenaires, de partenaires économiques, académiques et institutionnels, acteurs de la formation, de la recherche et du développement économique. 

Pour en savoir plus :

  • Vidéo de présentation de l’IMT :

  • Site carrière de l’IMT : https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/

  • Site web de l’IMT : https://www.imt.fr/

QUELLES MISSIONS VOUS ATTENDENT AU SEIN DE L’IMT ?

La Direction de la communication de l'IMT vous propose un stage de rédaction scientifique, d’une durée de 6 mois, à partir de janvier 2027

Vous serez sous la responsabilité directe de la responsable du pôle Information et communication scientifiques de l’IMT.

Vos missions :

§  Communication scientifique :

  •  Réalisation d’interviews, rédaction et publication d’articles de vulgarisation scientifique sur les sujets Recherche & innovation de l’Institut pour le média d’actualités I’MTech : résultats de travaux de recherche, suivi de projets, portrait de chercheurs, chercheuses, transfert de technologie, création de start-up, plateformes technologiques…

  • Possibilité de Community management (LinkedIn)

  • Assistance à tout autre projet de communication scientifique

§  Veille informationnelle :

  •  Veille interne sur les sujets d'actualité dans les domaines de la recherche et de l’innovation au sein de nos laboratoires et écoles + veille externe sur l’actualité scientifique.

Retrouvez l’offre en détail ici


QUI RECHERCHONS-NOUS ?

Vous suivez une formation universitaire en journalisme / communication scientifique, ou ingénieure et avez un goût pour la rédaction.

Vous avez le profil suivant :

  • Maîtrise des techniques de rédaction et de vulgarisation scientifique

  • Maîtrise des outils informatiques (essentiellement Wordpress et éventuellement des réseaux sociaux

  • Capacités d'organisation, sens de l’initiative, autonomie

  • Intérêt pour la recherche et l’innovation (domaines du numérique, de l’énergie, de l’environnement et des matériaux notamment)

  • Sens du relationnel (pour les interviews)

  • Maîtrise de l'anglais.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? 

En intégrant l’IMT, vous rejoindrez le premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France, présent sur tout le territoire. Vous deviendrez un·e acteur·rice clé du monde de demain en travaillant au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation dans un environnement d'excellence, à l'échelle nationale et internationale. L’Institut Mines-Télécom s’appuie sur la qualité de ses personnels et son intelligence collective pour imaginer et contribuer à la construction d'un avenir durable et agir sur les transformations.

title: Research Engineer
description: Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments? Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI? Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution? If your answers are yes, we should talk. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery. Offer essentials Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day. Relocation package. Flexible working hours. English-speaking environment. Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too: We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now. We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance. High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company. World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together. We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI. What you will do Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn. Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code. Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs. Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts. A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones. A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments. Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use. Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies. Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi. Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access. Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems. Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing. Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure. Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents. Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As HR Generalist, you are the go-to HR contact for managers and teams in Crissier and Zurich. You turn company priorities into concrete HR actions: contract administration, onboarding, development, employee relations and compliance with Swiss employment law.

 
 

Responsibilities

Manager & Employee Partnership

  • Work in close collaboration with R&D management to support them in the design of the organization

  • Act as the single HR contact for Switzerland: present daily in Crissier, and a reliable remote partner for Zurich with regular visits

  • Give managers concrete, operational HR answers grounded in Swiss law, and address employee concerns promptly

  • Communicate with the teams with pedagogy to support and explain the organization

Stay aligned with the Paris HR team and group policy while remaining locally compliant

Local Compliance & Employment Law

  • Own compliance with Swiss employment law across the employee lifecycle (contracts, probation, working time, leave, termination) and adapt group contracts and HR policies to Swiss requirements

  • Manage relations with cantonal labor and migration authorities (Vaud and Zurich): filings, registrations, inspections

  • Handle employee representation obligations as headcount grows and keep leadership ahead of regulatory change

Payroll & Social Declarations

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle with our provider and Finance: validate variable inputs (absences, overtime, bonuses, joiners, leavers) and cross-check payslips

  • Ensure timely social and tax declarations and manage benefits (health, accident, pension)

HR Operations & Personnel Administration

  • Manage individual employee situations end to end: disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, sensitive cases

  • Handle personnel administration (contracts, amendments, files, certificates), run absences in HiBob and produce HR metrics

  • Own work permit applications (G, B,L) for foreign nationals joining Crissier and Zurich: file with the DGEM, follow up until approval, and handle related cantonal and residence formalities

Onboarding, Offboarding & Mobility

  • Work with Talent Acquisition, who own recruitment: take over once an offer is accepted and run contracts, administration and onboarding for both sites

Skills

  • Credibility with managers and engineers; able to advise and decide

  • Rigor, confidentiality, autonomy and a taste for building processes

  • Comfort with an HRIS (HiBob) and reporting tools

Languages

  • Fluent French and English; Swiss-German is an asset for Zurich

Nice to have

  • Experience in defense, aerospace or deeptech, and with multi-site teams

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Junior Network & IT Security Engineer (a)
description: Dein künftiger Arbeitgeber ist ein internationales tätiges Schweizer Familienunternehmen der Industrietechnologie mit Sitz in der Ostschweiz. Seine Produkte stecken in Maschinen und Anlagen auf der ganzen Welt, entsprechend vernetzt ist die IT-Landschaft mit Standorten auf mehreren Kontinenten. Das IT-Security-Team schützt diese globale Infrastruktur und baut die Sicherheit Schritt für Schritt weiter aus. Für den Einstieg in dieses Team suchen wir eine Person, die technisch solide startet und Security mit Begeisterung in die Organisation trägt. Meine Herausforderungen Sicherheitsmassnahmen für Netzwerk und IT-Infrastruktur an allen Standorten umsetzen und laufend weiterentwickeln. Sicherheitsvorfälle und Bedrohungen analysieren, passende Massnahmen einleiten und die Ursachen nachhaltig beheben. Sicherheitsüberprüfungen, Schwachstellenanalysen und Audits durchführen und die Verbesserungen bis zur Umsetzung begleiten. Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Standards und Prozesse mitgestalten und so verankern, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden. Mit Fachbereichen und IT-Teams zusammenarbeiten, damit Sicherheitsanforderungen schon in frühen Projektphasen einfliessen. Mitarbeitende für Cyberrisiken sensibilisieren und ein gemeinsames Verständnis für Informationssicherheit fördern. Neue Entwicklungen in Cyber Security verfolgen und Erkenntnisse sowie Best Practices ins Team einbringen. Meine Kompetenzen Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder IT-Sicherheit oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundiertem technischem Verständnis. Erste praktische Erfahrung in IT Security, etwa aus Praktikum, Lehre, Werkstudium oder einer ersten Festanstellung. Kenntnisse in Netzwerksicherheit, Firewalls und Verschlüsselungstechnologien sowie echtes Interesse an aktuellen Bedrohungen und Schutzmassnahmen. Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Zusammenhänge rasch erkennen und lösungsorientiert vorgehen. title: Data Platform Manager
description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. Requirements What You’ll Need Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field. 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams. Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope. Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there. Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases. Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI. Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus. Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it. Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Who You Are You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head. You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it. You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.   Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
description: About the role Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. What You'll Do Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on. Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data. Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it. Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery. Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review. Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first. Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves. Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month. Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions. Requirements What You’ll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field. A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures. Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS. Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills. Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back. Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click. A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred. Who You Are You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one. You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through. Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.   Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

description: <h2><strong>Your Role in Our Story:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">As our Enterprise Architecture, you will play a key role in shaping ACT's technology direction as we continue to grow our global trading business and expand our digital capabilities.You'll take ownership of our enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring that our technology platforms, systems and investments work together to support business growth. Working at Group level, you'll reporting to Global IT Director and partner closely with senior leadership to influence strategic decisions, bring alignment across teams and build a scalable technology landscape for the future. In essence, your role involves:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Shape our enterprise architecture strategy:</strong> Define and drive a clear technology vision and roadmap across business, applications, data and technology, aligned with ACT's commercial priorities.</li> <li><strong>Drive alignment across the Group:</strong> Ensure technology initiatives and platforms work together, reducing complexity, duplication and fragmented solutions.</li> <li><strong>Lead architecture governance:</strong> Establish principles and standards, guide key architecture decisions and challenge investments where needed to ensure long-term scalability and business value.</li> <li><strong>Influence strategic technology investments:</strong> Advise senior leadership on technology priorities, platform choices and opportunities to optimise our technology landscape.</li> <li><strong>Enable business and digital growth:</strong> Support the development of integrated platforms and client-facing digital solutions, ensuring technology can scale alongside the business.</li> <li><strong>Build and develop architecture capabilities:</strong> Strengthen the enterprise architecture function, coach and develop expertise, and collaborate closely with engineering, data, security and business leaders.</li> <li><strong>Act as a strategic business partner:</strong> Work directly with the COO, Global IT Director and other senior stakeholders, translating business ambitions into practical technology direction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes:</p> <ul> <li>A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. A Master's degree in technology or business is an advantage.</li> <li>10–15 years of progressive experience in architecture and technology, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.</li> <li>Proven ability to define and drive enterprise architecture strategy, governance and roadmaps across complex organisations, while influencing executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Deep expertise across business, application, data and integration architecture, including cloud platforms, APIs and modern design patterns.</li> <li>Solid knowledge of established frameworks and methodologies, such as TOGAF and business-capability modelling, with the ability to apply them pragmatically.</li> <li>A track record of technology portfolio rationalisation, reducing complexity, identifying consolidation opportunities and optimising investments.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgment, translating technical decisions into measurable business value while balancing cost, scalability, risk and speed to market.</li> <li>Collaborative and influential leadership style, with experience building architecture capabilities, coaching teams and driving change across an organisation.</li> <li>Background in trading, financial services, commodities or other data-intensive, regulated environments is highly advantageous, alongside experience architecting integrated, client-facing digital platforms.</li> </ul> <p>If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

The Mendix Platform uses visual modeling to abstract long-form coding out of application development. Our customers use Mendix to create and deploy better software for the enterprise, faster. Mendix enables collaboration between business users and developers to work together throughout the development process.

Read our Customer Stories to learn more about the wealth of software and solutions global organizations have built with the Platform.

At Mendix we strive to maintain a diverse, open, and safe working environment where people can be their true selves. We value every voice, celebrate individuality, and appreciate the diversity of thought and experience. People who work here are driven, smart, and really good at what they do.

As this market evolves, we encourage people of all skill levels to work with the platform, both for clients and candidates. Apply today to discover how you can make a meaningful impact with Mendix.

Join our team as a Senior Consultant Lead Developer and embark on an exciting journey where you will advise and implement technical solutions for our esteemed customers across The Netherlands and the rest of EMEA. As a key player in our organization, your primary focus will be to guide our customers and partners in seamlessly integrating the Mendix App Platform into their enterprise landscape and processes. Collaborating closely with enterprise and application architects, as well as customer/partner teams, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the success of the adoption of the Mendix platform. This dynamic role offers the unique advantage of engaging with multiple projects and diverse customers, providing a rich and varied experience compared to traditional long-term client placements. 
 
We are searching for enthusiastic and innovative individuals with a proven track record in IT development and shown experience in customer-facing roles such as architect, consultant, or engineer.   • Passion for cloud-native and mobile technologies like Responsive, PWA, or Native 

  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and driven to find sophisticated solutions to complex problems 

  • Proven leadership and project delivery skills, either as a software project lead or within an organization focused on software development 

  • Engaging and professional demeanour, motivated to work with customers and drive innovation within their organizations 

  • Hands-on experience with common CI/CD tooling, such as GIT/SVN, Gitlab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Netherlands. Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems. Accountabilities You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include: Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews. Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services. Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously. Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies. Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes. Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance. Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels. Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools. Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines. Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them. Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include: At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review. Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users. Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code. Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks. Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls. Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies. Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password. Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code. Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring. Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust. Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts. Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs. Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts. A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones. A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments. Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use. Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies. Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi. Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access. Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems. Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing. Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure. Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents. Benefits Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely. Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan. Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States. Home office allowance: Receive a one-time allowance of $1,500 to set up your home workspace. Professional development: Access an annual book allowance of $200 to support continuous learning. Connectivity reimbursement: Receive $75 per month toward internet or phone expenses. Flexible time off: Benefit from flexible paid time off arrangements. Work equipment: Receive a company-issued laptop. Well-being support: Access egg-freezing benefits, mental health resources, and employee wellness programs. Inclusive workplace: Work in an environment committed to equal opportunity, accessibility, and providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!  Why Apply Through Jobgether?     Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.     #LI-CL1 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
raw.description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

raw.title: Security Architect
raw.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.</li> <li>A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.</li> <li>A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.</li> <li>Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.</li> <li>Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.</li> <li>Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stand-out experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.</li> <li>Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.</li> <li>Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.</li> <li>Have managed managers or multiple teams (~15 to 20+ engineers), owned a multi-year platform strategy, and grown tech leads and managers.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
